focuses.desc:
France has lost the war. The Third Republic voted itself out of existence in a casino theatre in Vichy, and handed everything to an eighty-four-year-old Marshal who won the last war at Verdun.

Vichy starts as a German satellite.
Effect: +10% stability, +50 political power.
focuses.name: Le Maréchal

focuses.desc:
Act No. 1: Philippe Pétain is Chief of the French State. The Republic is not abolished. It is simply never mentioned again.

Effect: +50 political power, +5% stability; elections abolished.
focuses.name: The Constitutional Acts

focuses.desc:
Liberty, Equality, Fraternity are chiselled off the town halls. Work, Family, Fatherland go up in their place.

Effect: spirit 'The National Revolution' (+10% stability, -5% consumer goods, +0.03 fascism drift).
focuses.name: Travail, Famille, Patrie

focuses.desc:
Every veteran of 1914 a member, every village a branch, every branch loyal to the Marshal.

Effect: +15% war support, +5000 manpower.
focuses.name: The Legion of Veterans

focuses.desc:
Blum, Daladier and Gamelin in the dock for losing the war. The trial is meant to prove the Republic's guilt; it may prove something else.

Effect: +10% stability, -10% democratic popularity.
focuses.name: The Riom Trial

focuses.desc:
The Marshal reigns. Someone else has to govern.

Effect: +50 political power.
focuses.name: Who Governs at Vichy?

focuses.desc:
Pierre Laval believes Germany has won and that France's only future is in Hitler's Europe. He intends to be first in line.

Effect: spirit 'Laval's Government' (+10% political power); +25 German opinion of us; -5% autonomy.
focuses.name: Laval Returns

focuses.desc:
Admiral Darlan holds the one card France has left: the fleet. He means to bargain with it, with Berlin and with everyone else.

Effect: spirit 'Darlan's Government' (+20% naval experience gain, +5% naval organisation); +5% autonomy.
focuses.name: Darlan's Government

focuses.desc:
Darnand's political police, in black berets, for hunting the Resistance where the Germans cannot be bothered to.

Effect: spirit 'The Milice' (+5% stability, +5% war support, -5% political power).
focuses.name: The Milice

focuses.desc:
The fleet at Toulon is the strongest thing France owns. It will sail for nobody - and everybody knows it could.

Effect: +1 dockyard in Toulon; spirit 'The Fleet at Toulon' (+10% naval organisation, +5% naval speed).
focuses.name: The Fleet in Being

focuses.desc:
A state without a republic, a government without a parliament, an army without a war. It works, after a fashion.

Effect: +15% stability, +100 political power.
focuses.name: The French State

focuses.desc:
Metropolitan France is half occupied. The Empire is not. Dakar, Algiers, Beirut, Hanoi: as long as they fly the tricolour, France is still a great power.

Available only while the war in the west goes on (before the Anglo-American peace).
Effect: spirit 'The Imperial Garrisons' (+5% army defence).
focuses.name: The Empire Holds

focuses.desc:
The British and de Gaulle came to Dakar in September 1940 and were driven off. They will come again.

Available only while the war in the west goes on (before the Anglo-American peace).
Effect: +1 naval base and +2 coastal forts in Senegal; +1000 infantry equipment.
focuses.name: Dakar Must Not Fall

focuses.desc:
General Weygand, Delegate-General in North Africa, quietly rebuilds the Army of Africa behind the armistice commission's back.

Available only while the war in the west goes on (before the Anglo-American peace).
Effect: +10% army organisation for 2 years; +1500 infantry equipment, +200 artillery.
focuses.name: Weygand in Algiers

focuses.desc:
General Dentz holds Syria and Lebanon with 35,000 men, and the British in Palestine and Iraq have noticed.

Available only while the war in the west goes on (before the Anglo-American peace).
Effect: +1 fort along the borders of Syria and Lebanon (ours or our subjects'); +500 infantry equipment.
focuses.name: The Army of the Levant

focuses.desc:
Admiral Decoux governs Indochina with 30,000 men, no reinforcements and the Japanese army on the border.

Available only while the war in the west goes on (before the Anglo-American peace).
Effect: Japan +25 opinion of us; +300 infantry equipment.
focuses.name: Decoux in Indochina

focuses.desc:
Senegalese tirailleurs, the backbone of the colonial army, re-equipped from Dakar's arsenal.

Available only while the war in the west goes on (before the Anglo-American peace).
Effect: +15000 manpower; +500 infantry equipment.
focuses.name: The West African Army

focuses.desc:
Officially 120,000 men. Unofficially rather more, hidden as labour companies and police.

Available only while the war in the west goes on (before the Anglo-American peace).
Effect: +1 military factory in Algiers; +2000 infantry equipment, +300 artillery.
focuses.name: The Army of Africa

focuses.desc:
Beirut will not be handed to the British without a fight.

Available only while the war in the west goes on (before the Anglo-American peace).
Effect: +25 army experience, +25 air experience.
focuses.name: Dentz Holds the Levant

focuses.desc:
Japanese troops may use Tonkin's airfields and railways. In return, the French flag stays up in Hanoi.

Available only while the war in the west goes on (before the Anglo-American peace).
Effect: Japan gets military access; Japan +25 opinion of us.
focuses.name: Bend to Tokyo

focuses.desc:
Diego-Suarez is the best harbour on the Indian Ocean, and the British want it.

Available only while the war in the west goes on (before the Anglo-American peace).
Effect: +1 naval base and +2 coastal forts in Madagascar; +5000 manpower.
focuses.name: The Madagascar Garrison

focuses.desc:
Chad, Cameroon and Equatorial Africa went over to de Gaulle in 1940. They can be brought back.

Available only while the war in the west goes on (before the Anglo-American peace).
Effect: +5% war support; claims on the Equatorial African colonies held by someone else.
focuses.name: Hunt the Gaullists

focuses.desc:
Admiral Robert's carrier at Martinique, Godfroy's cruisers at Alexandria, the gold in Fort-de-France: scattered, but still French.

Available only while the war in the west goes on (before the Anglo-American peace).
Effect: +1 naval base in the French Caribbean; +25 navy experience.
focuses.name: The Overseas Squadrons

focuses.desc:
Three years of war, and the Empire has not fallen. Whatever the peace brings, France comes to the table with a world behind it.

Available only while the war in the west goes on (before the Anglo-American peace).
Effect: if we still hold Senegal, Algiers, Madagascar and Tonkin: spirit 'The Imperial Shield' (+10% stability, +5% recruitable population) and cores on Algeria. Otherwise +75 political power.
focuses.name: The Empire Endures

focuses.desc:
The Marshal shakes Hitler's hand at a railway station in the Loir-et-Cher. 'I enter today upon the path of collaboration.'

Available only while the war in the west goes on (before the Anglo-American peace).
Effect: +25 German opinion of us; +50 political power.
focuses.name: Montoire

focuses.desc:
Four hundred million francs a day, for the privilege of being occupied. Perhaps it can be three hundred.

Available only while the war in the west goes on (before the Anglo-American peace).
Effect: the Occupation Costs spirit is reduced one step.
focuses.name: Negotiate the Occupation Costs

focuses.desc:
Bizerte, Dakar and the Syrian airfields for German use, in exchange for concessions that never quite arrive.

Available only while the war in the west goes on (before the Anglo-American peace).
Effect: Germany gets military access; +25 German opinion of us; -5% autonomy towards Germany.
focuses.name: The Paris Protocols

focuses.desc:
Three workers to Germany for every prisoner of war who comes home.

Available only while the war in the west goes on (before the Anglo-American peace).
Effect: +20000 manpower (returning prisoners); -5% stability.
focuses.name: La Relève

focuses.desc:
French factories work for German orders. Better German orders than no orders at all.

Available only while the war in the west goes on (before the Anglo-American peace).
Effect: +2 civilian factories; +10% production efficiency growth for 2 years.
focuses.name: German Contracts

focuses.desc:
Doriot and Déat send French volunteers in German uniform to fight Bolshevism in Russia.

Available only while the war in the west goes on (before the Anglo-American peace).
Effect: +25 German opinion of us; -5% stability; +25 army experience.
focuses.name: The Legion of French Volunteers

focuses.desc:
Volunteering was not enough. Young men are now conscripted for German factories, and many take to the hills instead.

Available only while the war in the west goes on (before the Anglo-American peace).
Effect: Germany gets +2 offsite military factories; -10% stability.
focuses.name: Compulsory Labour Service

focuses.desc:
Renault builds trucks for the Wehrmacht, Gnome-Rhône builds aero engines. The war economy runs through France.

Available only while the war in the west goes on (before the Anglo-American peace).
Effect: +3 civilian factories, +1 military factory; Germany +10 opinion.
focuses.name: Workshop of the Reich

focuses.desc:
When the peace comes, France must sit with the victors, not on the menu.

Available only while the war in the west goes on (before the Anglo-American peace).
Effect: +10% war support; La Paix Allemande later gives an extra +5% stability and +50 political power.
focuses.name: A Place at the Victors' Table

focuses.desc:
The Americans have made peace, Britain has a Reichsprotektor, and the war in the west is over. The German peace has come to France.

Available once the war in the west is won (the Anglo-American peace, or Germany's Totaler Sieg).
Effect: the Occupation Costs spirit is removed; +10% stability.
focuses.name: La Paix Allemande

focuses.desc:
The occupied zone is handed back: Paris, the north and the Atlantic coast, everything but Alsace-Lorraine. The government leaves the spa town for the capital.

Effect: Germany returns every French core state it owns except Alsace-Lorraine (and what the SS has taken); capital moves to Paris.
focuses.name: The Return to Paris

focuses.desc:
A million and a half men, five years in German camps, coming home on the same trains that took them.

Effect: +150000 manpower; +10% stability.
focuses.name: The Prisoners Come Home

focuses.desc:
Lille, Rouen, Calais: bombed by both sides and stripped by one.

Effect: +2 civilian factories and +1 infrastructure in every northern state.
focuses.name: Rebuild the North

focuses.desc:
The Marshal's constitution, drafted in 1944 and never promulgated, is promulgated.

Effect: +10% stability, +100 political power.
focuses.name: A New Constitution

focuses.desc:
France is a province of the German economic sphere: coal from the Ruhr, iron from Lorraine, wheat from the Beauce, all priced in Reichsmarks.

Effect: spirit 'The German Sphere' (+10% factory output, -10% trade opinion outside the Reich).
focuses.name: The Grossraumwirtschaft

focuses.desc:
What the Reich does not want, the Empire can buy: Algerian wine, Moroccan phosphate, Indochinese rubber.

Effect: +2 civilian factories in Algiers; spirit 'Imperial Preference' (+10% resource output).
focuses.name: Imperial Preference

focuses.desc:
French engineering, German capital, European markets. The Marshal's ministers call it partnership.

Effect: +3 military factories, +10% production efficiency cap.
focuses.name: Workshop of the New Europe

focuses.desc:
Pétain is ninety. His mind wanders in the afternoons, and every faction at Vichy has noticed.

Effect: -5% stability; the succession opens.
focuses.name: The Marshal Grows Old

focuses.desc:
The collaborator's collaborator, Chief of State at last.

Effect: Laval leads France; +25 German opinion; +15% political power gain.
focuses.name: Laval Succeeds

focuses.desc:
Jacques Doriot, the communist who became a fascist, comes back from the Russian front to take power.

Effect: Doriot leads France (fascist); +20% fascism popularity; +15% war support.
focuses.name: Doriot Succeeds

focuses.desc:
The admiral who kept the fleet now keeps the State.

Effect: Darlan leads France (non-aligned); +10% stability; +25% naval experience gain.
focuses.name: Darlan Succeeds

focuses.desc:
The Marshal is dead. Long live the French State.

Effect: +15% stability, +150 political power.
focuses.name: The New Chief of State

focuses.desc:
A letter from Himmler's office: Franche-Comté, Champagne and Picardy - the east of France - are German from today. Nobody in Berlin asked Vichy.

Available once Germany has completed 'Requisition Territory from Our French Puppet'.
Effect: -10% stability; +10% war support.
focuses.name: The Requisition

focuses.desc:
The ambassador delivers a note. It is filed.

Effect: +10% stability; -15 German opinion of us; +5% autonomy.
focuses.name: Protest in Berlin

focuses.desc:
France has lost provinces before, and got them back.

Effect: +25 German opinion of us; -5% stability; +50 political power.
focuses.name: Accept the New Border

focuses.desc:
The SS empties the requisitioned lands of anyone who will not be Germanised. They arrive at the new border with one suitcase each.

Effect: +20000 manpower; -5% stability; +1 building slot in Paris (refugee housing).
focuses.name: Expelled from the East

focuses.desc:
Himmler has his Ordensstaat: Burgundy, a state run by the SS, on French soil and on France's frontier.

Available only if the Ordensstaat Burgund exists.
Effect: +15% war support; +2 fort levels in every state bordering Burgundy.
focuses.name: A Black Order on Our Border

focuses.desc:
Barbed wire and machine guns along a border that did not exist five years ago.

Effect: +1 fort along every state bordering Burgundy; spirit 'The Burgundian Frontier' (+5% army defence).
focuses.name: Close the Burgundian Frontier

focuses.desc:
Not everyone the SS rules wants to be ruled by the SS. Those who can, cross over to us.

Effect: +15000 manpower; +research bonus (engineers and scientists fleeing Burgundy).
focuses.name: The Burgundian Refugees

focuses.desc:
Franche-Comté, Champagne, Picardy, Alsace-Lorraine. One day.

Effect: claims on every French state held by Burgundy; +10% war support.
focuses.name: French Soil Is French

focuses.desc:
Berlin is at war with itself. For the first time since 1940, nobody in Germany has time for France.

Available once the German civil war has begun.
Effect: +10% stability, +50 political power.
focuses.name: The Reich Burns

focuses.desc:
The armistice commission has gone home. The garrisons have marched east to fight each other. France governs itself again.

Effect: we are no longer a German subject, but we stay in the Axis: we keep our faction membership.
focuses.name: Sovereignty Restored

focuses.desc:
Leaving the alliance would be easy. Surviving without it would not. Without the Reich's remaining allies behind us, de Gaulle comes back - and he will not come alone.

Effect: +25 opinion with every faction member; +10% war support. If the faction has broken up in the civil war, we join the faction of the strongest remaining German ally.
focuses.name: The Axis Is Our Shield

focuses.desc:
Brittany, Normandy and the Loire rise for Free France the moment the Germans leave. It was always going to happen.

Effect: +20% war support; +3000 infantry equipment; +10% army attack for a year.
focuses.name: The Gaullist Rising

focuses.desc:
No armistice limits, no German inspectors. The armée de l'armistice becomes the French Army again.

Effect: spirit 'The Army Reborn' (+10% army organisation); +2 military factories; +2000 infantry equipment, +400 artillery.
focuses.name: The Army Reborn

focuses.desc:
The Gaullists hold the west. The French State holds everything else.

Effect: war goal on Free France if it exists and we are not already at war; +10% army attack for a year.
focuses.name: Crush Free France

focuses.desc:
The SS state is fighting for its life against the Wehrmacht. Its western flank is open.

Available only if the Ordensstaat Burgund exists and has NO nuclear weapons - nobody, the AI included, attacks an SS state that can burn Paris.
Effect: war goal on Burgundy; claims on its French states.
focuses.name: Reclaim Burgundy

focuses.desc:
The SS can keep its black castle in the east. France has bled enough, and the men in Dijon have nothing left to lose.

Available only if the Ordensstaat Burgund exists.
Effect: Burgundy and France will not go to war with each other (non-aggression); +10% stability; the claims on Burgundy are kept for another day.
focuses.name: Leave Burgundy Be

focuses.desc:
France alone - Maurras' old slogan, now a fact. Ten years after the defeat, the French State stands on its own feet.

Effect: +15% stability, +15% war support, +1 research slot.
focuses.name: La France Seule
